outcome: The results panel now has its own model and commands (MVC stage 3, part 1 of 2)
owner_impact: Nothing changes on screen. The results panel (plots of the live metrics) now works like the simulation panel. Its state (status line, whether a plot can be added, the metrics and the plots with their selected metrics) lives in one results model, written by the code that receives the metric samples. Its actions (add plot, remove plot, show or hide a metric, follow live data) are commands. The React panel reads only the model and calls only the commands; the old plot buttons, and the module that clears plots when an Experiment changes, call the same commands. Proof: identical real actions on the production version and on this one gave identical results at all 11 steps: run, add plot, toggle a metric, zoom then Follow live (the plot image returns exactly to its live view), remove through the panel, remove the way another module does, restart. A deliberately broken copy was caught at the right step. Test now: optional quick look. Run an Experiment, add a plot, change its metrics, zoom into a plot and press Follow live, remove a plot.

next.text: #564 continues with part 2: the authoring (code editor) panel gets its own model and commands in the same way. Nothing changes on screen.

technical_evidence: New web/src/results/results-model.js and results-commands.js, each one shared instance: external to the React bundle (vite SHARED_MODULE) and guarded by verify-dist.

results-ui.js publishes status, canAdd, metrics (configured ones labelled; sample-only ones by id, as before) and panel bindings to the model, and provides addPanel, removePanel, toggleMetric (configured metrics only, as the checkboxes allowed) and followLive. The legacy buttons and checkboxes call the same commands.
results-react-adapter.ts reads only the results model and calls only the commands: no page watchers, no clicks, no __vlabResultsUI.

A/B in a real browser, production build versus this build, same scripted real input: 11/11 steps identical, including plot-image fingerprints before zoom and after Follow live. A planted copy where Follow live does nothing is caught at that step.
Tests: 670 pass (new results-commands.test.mjs; #198/#261 source checks now assert the model/controller wiring). Style comparison identical at all four viewports.
